day_shape: 61 items: Trump declares Strait of Hormuz cleared of mines with destruction threat, Treasury 'Operation Economic Outcast' sanctions wave and $10m IRGC bounties, reported US sanctions-relief offer for Hormuz reopening, heavy Pezeshkian/Khamenei post-agreement messaging; nothing from UK Parliament or IAEA.

threads.label: US economic pressure campaign on Iran
threads.summary: OFAC published a new SDN designation notice while Treasury's 'Operation Economic Outcast' bundled sanctions on dozens of Iran-linked entities with secondary threats against trading partners. Iran International and Jerusalem Post reported China warned of retaliation if its firms are targeted, per Financial Times.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and sanctions-relief offer
threads.summary: Trump said the US Navy has cleared all mines from the Strait of Hormuz and threatened immediate destruction of vessels laying new mines. Jerusalem Post cited Al-Hadath reporting a US offer of sanctions relief in exchange for reopening the Strait and halting proxy attacks.

threads.label: Rewards for Justice IRGC bounties
threads.summary: The State Department's Rewards for Justice programme offered up to $10 million for information on five senior IRGC leaders, one of whom was killed in an April IDF airstrike. Jerusalem Post also reported the State Department is preparing to return diplomats to Middle East embassies evacuated during the Iran war.

threads.label: Tehran messaging on agreement and defiance
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted a readout of a seven-hour Pezeshkian–Khamenei meeting citing 'national unity' guidance, while IRIB and Defa Press carried Pezeshkian saying the signed agreement was 'not surrender'. Regime channels also carried Rezaei telling Iraq's judiciary chief that 'America will have no place in the region's future' and the acting defence minister warning livelihood pressure equals war.

threads.label: Iran border-defence and IRGC posture claims
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB quoted General Goshtasbi saying enemy ground-movement plans on the northwestern axis were prevented, and Admiral Jahantshahi claiming the Army Ground Forces had neutralised enemy ground-warfare plans. Iran's parliament also advanced an amended bill defining foreign agents and contacts, per Iran International.

threads.label: Gaza strikes, Board of Peace and kites ultimatum
threads.summary: IDF chief Zamir said hunts for October 7 perpetrators continue in Gaza despite Board of Peace calls to limit strikes, and the IDF said it struck five Hamas weapon depots inside mosques and near aid sites. The Board of Peace conveyed a message demanding Hamas halt kite launches, with parents warned to stop children flying kites.

threads.label: Axis of resistance messaging
threads.summary: Regime channels amplified Houthi leader Abdul Malik al-Houthi calling aggression against Iran, Lebanon, Syria and Yemen part of a US-Israeli conspiracy, and Yemen's defence minister claiming 'devastating deterrent capabilities'. Jerusalem Post reported Hezbollah MP Fadlallah met FM Araghchi in Tehran urging 'coordinated and decisive measures' against Israel.
